big_case.notes: A State's application to vacate a Fifth Circuit stay of a remand order, on an acknowledged circuit split over whether Griggs/Coinbase-style automatic stays extend to post-transmittal federal-officer-removal appeals. The question recurs across the climate/coastal/opioid removal wave and touches state-court authority, but it is a procedural federal-courts issue on the interim docket, decided by a one-line denial, with the related City of Brunswick petition as the more natural vehicle.
